### Play at full-screen at any aspect ratio (32:9/16:10/4:3/3:2...), one tap per game.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
**AnyAspectRatio** finds the games you own, installs the right aspect-ratio fix, and sets the launch options for you.
On **SteamOS, Windows, macOS and Linux**. No file copying, no terminal.

## Install

- **Steam Deck / SteamOS / DroidDeck (Decky plugin):** [guide](https://github.com/TLin-Y/SteamAnyAspectRatioMods/blob/main/AnyAspectRatioDecky/README.md)
- **Windows / macOS / Linux (desktop app):** [guide](https://github.com/TLin-Y/SteamAnyAspectRatioMods/blob/main/AnyAspectRatioDesktop/README.md)

## What's new in v2.1.0

- **Safer Apply:** if Apply fails, the original files it had replaced are put back.
- **Desktop app updates:** a button to check for a new version in the app.
- **Mods tab:** mods are grouped by author, with links to their pages.
